name: Bug Report 🐛
about: Report a bug, false scroll count, or detection issue
title: "[Bug]: "
labels: ["bug"]
assignees: []
---

### 🐛 Description of Bug
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

### 📱 Device Information
- **Device Model**: (e.g., Google Pixel 8, Samsung Galaxy S23, OnePlus 11)
- **Android Version**: (e.g., Android 14, Android 15)
- **App Version**: ScrollStop v1.0.0 (or check in app under Community & Updates)
- **Instagram / YouTube App Version**: (e.g., Instagram v340.x, YouTube v19.x)

### 🔁 Steps to Reproduce
1. Open Instagram / YouTube
2. Go to Reels / Shorts
3. Scroll through videos
4. Observe false count / unexpected behavior

### 🎯 Expected Behavior
A clear description of what you expected to happen.

### 📸 Screenshots or Screen Recording (if applicable)
Add screenshots or screen recordings to help explain the problem.

### 📝 Additional Context
Any other context, custom battery saver settings, or launcher details.
